syntheses.title: Lack of Direct Comparative Evaluation of End-to-End CNN and RNN Mid-Level Approaches in Autonomous Driving
syntheses.body: The claims describe two different autonomous driving methods: an end-to-end CNN approach that learns the entire processing pipeline to steer a car (claim e66d15a0-9347-5814-b053-1ff1dea8058d from paper A) and an RNN-based ChauffeurNet that uses mid-level input and outputs driving trajectories (claim cc49c2d4-b50d-5322-8525-304268249b24 from paper B). While both methods are detailed, there is no claim providing a direct comparative evaluation of these two approaches under the same conditions or metrics. This gap limits understanding of their relative strengths and weaknesses in autonomous driving tasks.
